name: weighted seated one arm reverse wrist curl
description: A one-arm reverse wrist curl, palm down, seated with a weight. It strengthens the top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm down.
Let your hand hang over your knee with the weight.
Lower your wrist for a stretch.
Lift your hand up as high as you can.
Complete your reps and switch arms.
